source_of_truth: Operator directive 2026-06-09 (C0 round-6 pause): the pre-impl sufficiency gate behaves as an unbounded contract enumerator — six C0 rounds each cleared 100% of prior findings and surfaced a fresh matrix layer (language x evidence type x tier x phase x fixture x status). Build a convergence rule BEFORE returning to C0: (1) sufficiency round tracking with finding count, cleared prior ids, new-finding severities, and a finding class (plan_contract / implementation_detail / editorial / scope_guard / matrix_pin); (2) a convergence policy — full clearance + only medium/low matrix_pin or implementation_detail findings requires operator disposition instead of another paid hard block, new highs keep blocking, new conceptual plan_contract findings block unless explicitly waived; (3) a disposition artifact (accepted_into_plan / deferred_to_impl / waived_with_reason / split_to_followup_plan); (4) dogfood against the six C0 rounds as fixtures.
completion_test: On a plan whose latest sufficiency round fully cleared all prior findings and produced only medium/low matrix_pin or implementation_detail findings, dontpanic plan lock returns operator_disposition_required naming the branch, and recording dispositions for each finding then permits the lock without a further paid call; on a round with a new high or undisposed plan_contract finding the lock still hard-blocks; the rounds ledger is reconstructable from committed evidence with stable finding ids; the six C0 rounds replay offline as fixtures with the asserted per-round verdicts and zero live auditor invocations.

user_journeys.name: convergent-lock
user_journeys.description: An operator iterating a contract-heavy plan reaches a bounded stopping point: the gate demands disposition instead of an unbounded paid tighten-relock spiral.

user_journeys.name: finding-disposition
user_journeys.description: An operator dispositions individual findings durably, with the lock honoring dispositions and re-surfacing a finding that recurs materially changed.

non_goals: Post-impl completion-gate convergence (pre-impl only in v0)
Auditor model or prompt changes beyond emitting the finding class
Unlocking C0 itself (follow-up step under the new policy)
